Owner-only membership operations

Verify a profile and reconcile an existing paid subscription.

This page does not create a charge. It uses the existing Franklin membership runtime and requires the Render ADMIN_TOKEN for owner authorization.

Secret handling

Enter the Render ADMIN_TOKEN only on this page. Do not paste it into ChatGPT, email, screenshots, source code, or receipts. The page keeps it only in browser memory for this session.

Checking your signed-in Franklin account…

1. Signed-in account and profile

If no linked profile appears, open Membership setup, sign in, and connect the exact Franklin profile first.

2. Owner authorization

Verify only after you have confirmed the account is authorized for the exact selected Franklin profile.

3. Reconcile an already-paid subscription

Use this only for a Stripe subscription that has already been paid and must be attached to this verified Franklin account/profile. It does not create a second payment.
